title: Hey, I'm Charles
body: Welcome! I'm Charles. A 26yo finally pursuing my childhood dream of becoming a game designer. Explore my journal entries on game dev, coding, meetup learnings, and fun side quests that involve games. It's mostly for me, but I hope you enjoy reading and learn something too. If an entry helps, subscribing would make my day. P.L.S. (Peace, love, and soul).
